editorial.blurb: This elegant Fulton Market Greek gem delivers authentic flavors and tableside theatre in a romantic, golden-lit dining room where every detail—from saganaki to deconstructed pastitsio—lands with precision.
editorial.insiderTip: Visit during their 'golden hour' happy hour for better cocktail pricing, and don't miss the tableside-prepared dishes; sharing mezze options (tzatziki, feta dips, meatballs, calamari) is a smart way to experience the menu's breadth.
